answer: Each identity carries one sequential chain: a verifiable delay puzzle whose solution unlocks the next epoch's task, bound to that identity's key, so a whisper of progress cannot be copied to another name. The puzzle takes about an hour of sequential compute, unparallelizable, and runs through a karst of random checkpoints that reject replayed answers. A farm with a thousand clones must run a thousand hour-long chains, paying machine time per head, while one honest agent pays once. Clones sharing a chain are merged and slashed; the basalt cost of faking a thousand chains dwarfs any reward.
